items.title: MXP London Startup Hackathon & Masterclass: Build Prototypes and Master Product Strategy in One Day (May 19)
items.summary: 🇬🇧 If you're based in London, this one's for you! MXP London: Startup Hackathon & Masterclass 📅 Tuesday, 19 May |📍Mixpanel London HQ, The Dock @ TIDE Bankside | 🆓 Free to attend We're hosting a one-day, product experience in partnership with ProductX and Replit, and there are still a handful of spots left. This isn't your typical hackathon. You'll go from strategy to working prototype in a single day, all built around one question: how do you make better product decisions when AI has changed how fast everyone can build? Here's how the day breaks down 👇 🧠 Morning masterclass with ProductX: a live session on Product Strategy in the AI Era. Why traditional prioritization frameworks are breaking down, and what a sharper decision-making framework actually looks like in practice. 💡 Hackathon sessions: work in small teams to define a problem, design a solution, and build a working prototype. The challenge prompt is revealed on the day, so no idea or team needed beforehand! 🔍 Expert product analysis: after presentations, a panel of experts will breakdown each team's solution, connecting the product choices back to real business outcomes. The stakes 🏆 • Winning team is announced during the MXP London main conference keynote on 21 May and takes home a cash prize • Every participant gets a free month of Replit Core Spots are limited to keep it tight and collaborative. If you're a founder, PM, or growth lead in London, come spend a Tuesday with us. 👉 Apply here: https://events.mixpanel.com/hackathon-london-2026/

items.title: Planet Releases First Light from Latest Pelican Launch, Including Imagery from Sweden’s First Sovereign Satellite
items.summary: Planet Labs PBC (NYSE: PL), a leading provider of daily data and insights about change on Earth, today released first light images from its latest Pelican launch, including the Swedish Armed Forces (SwAF)’s first ever sovereign satellite. Planet launched these three Pelican spacecraft to orbit aboard the CAS500-2 rideshare mission with SpaceX from Vandenberg Space Force Base in California on May 3, 2026. Ambursu, Nigeria • May 11, 2026 • Altitude: 510 km • Pelican Planet received high-resolution first light imagery from the Pelican satellites within days of their May 3 launch. Each satellite captured imagery from around the world, including Gotland, Sweden, on May 7, 2026, from an altitude of 515 km; Taiyuan, in Shanxi, China, on May 5, 2026, from an altitude of 512 km; and Ambursu, Nigeria, on May 11, 2026, from an altitude of 510 km. As the spacecraft complete the instrument calibration process and reach their final operational orbits, image quality is expected to further improve.
